method: Bounded inspection of newly valid semantic links, selected or basis evidence, admission decisions, and source provenance; no Gold answer used as an implementation target
targeted_finding: The four previously reviewed ambiguous incomplete questions remain without a VALID visible-only basis citing rejected selected evidence after exact G2 replay. Newly completed n024 and n028 are answered with complete VALID point coverage and other admitted basis IDs; their rejected Sphinx overview page is not a basis for a valid disposition. No page relevance or rejected-item frequency was promoted to a causal admission defect.
decision_basis: All 28 frozen QA cases completed. Exact production G2 replay consistently recovered the surviving VALID children in all three PARTIAL cases without promoting LOCAL_INVALID siblings. Across the fixed cohort, no VALID visible-only disposition links selected rejected evidence to an answer-authorization failure, so there is no Tier 1 link or Tier 2 admission-policy candidate. Nineteen AMBIGUOUS_BACKING rejections remain real Tier 0 observations; this bounded decision does not assert the absence of latent corpus gaps or establish a generalization score.
